# Accounting for Everyone

> A comprehensive guide to double-entry bookkeeping, accounting fundamentals, and professional development for bookkeepers and accountants.

Accounting for Everyone offers a certified 12-week online bookkeeping course alongside educational resources covering Chart of Accounts, bookkeeping functions, ethics, and professional practices. The platform serves learners globally across the UK, USA, Australia, Canada, and South Africa with practical guides and interactive assessments.

## Key Topics

- Double-entry bookkeeping
- Chart of Accounts
- Credits and debits
- Bookkeeping fundamentals
- Bookkeeper responsibilities
- Accounting ratios
- Bookkeeping ethics
- QuickBooks
- Xero
- Sage
- Google Sheets
- VAT
- Bookkeeping business marketing
- Senior partner leadership
- Certified bookkeeping course

## Core Courses & Learning

- [Accounting for Everyone Online Certified Bookkeeping Course](https://accountingforeveryone.com/accounting-for-everyone-online-certified-bookkeeping-course): Main certified 12-week bookkeeping course with lifetime membership
- [Accounting for Everyone Week 1](https://accountingforeveryone.com/accounting-for-everyone-week-1): Week 1 course introduction covering Chart of Accounts and double-entry basics
- [The Accounting for Everyone Quiz](https://accountingforeveryone.com/the-accounting-for-everyone-quiz): Interactive quizzes to test bookkeeping and accounting knowledge

## Bookkeeping Fundamentals

- [Accounting Ratios And What They Mean](https://accountingforeveryone.com/accounting-ratios): Guide to accounting ratios, equations, and financial analysis fundamentals
- [Major Bookkeeping Functions](https://accountingforeveryone.com/what-are-bookkeeping-functions): Guide to key bookkeeping functions and bookkeeper responsibilities
- [Bookkeeping Duties For Bookkeepers](https://accountingforeveryone.com/what-are-bookkeeping-duties): Guide to bookkeeper duties and financial record-keeping responsibilities
- [What Are The Major Bookkeeping Skills?](https://accountingforeveryone.com/what-are-bookkeeping-skills): Guide to essential bookkeeping skills and accounting software competencies
- [Bookkeeping Ethics and Ensuring We All Follow Best Practice](https://accountingforeveryone.com/what-are-bookkeeping-ethics): Guide to bookkeeping ethics and professional standards in accounting

## Specialized Guides & Resources

- [Keeping Accounts For Small Clubs – A Simple Guide](https://accountingforeveryone.com/keeping-accounts-for-small-clubs-a-simple-guide): Beginner guide to club treasurer accounting and nonprofit finances
- [The Ultimate Guide to Marketing Your Bookkeeping Business Online](https://accountingforeveryone.com/the-ultimate-guide-to-marketing-your-bookkeeping-business-online): Guide to marketing bookkeeping services and targeting clients online
- [Glossary A to M](https://accountingforeveryone.com/glossary-a-to-m): Accounting and bookkeeping terminology reference guide A-M

## Articles & Professional Development

- [Selection of Accounting and Bookkeeping Articles](https://accountingforeveryone.com/selection-of-accounting-and-bookkeeping-articles): Collection of articles on GAAP, mergers, accrued liabilities, and practices
- [From Rainmaker to Visionary: Strategic Leadership in Global Firms](https://accountingforeveryone.com/from-rainmaker-to-visionary-strategic-leadership-as-a-senior-partner-in-a-global-accounting-firm): Article on strategic leadership and firm management for senior partners
- [Balancing Billable Hours and Boardroom Decisions: Senior Partner Insights](https://accountingforeveryone.com/balancing-billable-hours-and-boardroom-decisions-the-hidden-realities-of-life-as-a-senior-partner): Article on senior partner responsibilities and firm strategy management
- [Mentorship, Succession, and Legacy: Shaping Future Leaders as a Senior Partner](https://accountingforeveryone.com/mentorship-succession-and-legacy-shaping-the-next-generation-as-a-senior-partner): Article on mentorship, succession planning, and leadership development
